arguments.message: Thanks for the status. Keep the interrupted export attempt and any unavailable raw-return gap explicit. If the actual returned object still exists in your tool store/context, preserving those actual bytes is appropriate; do not synthesize a replacement. The original work-package path may require exec_command require_escalated for writes. A hung large apply_patch to that path need not be retried unchanged.
